topic: Two original class-1 vehicle active physics update and camera callbacks with moving stock GTSi and bus roots
summary: Original 00463800 class callback invokes original 0043A3C0 and 0043BDF0 with controlled drive and 1/60 delta for two consecutive update/camera frames in persistent native-constructed and registered GTSi/bus. Root pose advances per original instructions, original 00406AB0 camera returns finite six-double states, independent bus traces identical. Root direction remains non-unit, so game/hardware parity and actual scheduler remain unresolved.

validation.notes: Independent source-versus-derived validator: exact original retail/GZF/ZFS identities, 38 retail PE opcode anchors, 6 original direct CALL displacements (3 checks each), four private source trace identities, original active frame class/camera events and native registration, bus and GTSi two-frame pose and camera field invariants, byte-identical independent bus replay, explicit numerical nonorthonormality caveat. Game scheduler/hardware parity untested.

methods: Pin accepted 1.0.3 repository policy and live GitHub ruleset.
Read-only Ghidra 12.1.4 v97 decompile and CALL target audit for class-1 active and inactive pose update paths.
Reuse separately checksum-verified private original GTSi/bus VCF/VLOC/TMT resources and native root/active-world registration.
Original i386 EmulatorHelper class-1 update 00463800, original drivetrain 0043A3C0/orientation 0043BDF0 and original default camera 00406AB0, twice without emulator reset, controlled inputs.
Two independent byte-identical selected-bus emulations and original GTSi replay; independent 169-assertion verifier on original PE opcode bytes, direct CALL targets and source private traces.
reproducibility.limitations: No genuine retail game scheduler, positive wheel-contact fixedstep accumulator or full terrain/collision. Controlled vehicle drive, dt, camera activity distance and pause inputs. Windows/CRT/resource, sine/cosine and x87-ftol services intercepted at stated boundaries. Moving root axis is not unit length in these tests; hardware x87 numeric parity, orthonormal pose, authentic camera/pixels unproven. Requires licensed resources and private Ghidra baseline not committed.
